chansons.style: Modern country storytelling, warm male vocal, acoustic guitar strumming, weeping steel guitar, nostalgic and heartfelt ambiance, 95 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un homme quitte la ville pour retrouver la paix de sa campagne natale.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Steel guitar)
[Verse 1]
I packed my bags when I was young and blind
Left the county line and never looked behind
Chased the neon lights and city skies of gray
But the concrete towers stole my breath away
[Pre-Chorus]
Now the miles are rolling under worn out tires
Heading back to where my tired heart desires
[Chorus]
Take me down that dusty road back home
Where the weeping willows and the wild weeds grow
Trading in the noise for a quiet porch
Lighting up a fire with a cedar torch
The dusty road is calling out my name
[Verse 2]
Passed the old mill standing by the creek
Haven't seen this water in a week
Well, a couple years is more like what I mean
But the valley looks exactly like a dream
[Chorus]
Take me down that dusty road back home
Where the weeping willows and the wild weeds grow
Trading in the noise for a quiet porch
Lighting up a fire with a cedar torch
The dusty road is calling out my name
[Bridge]
Every gravel stone is a memory I kept
Every faded sign is a promise I swept
[Outro]
Yeah, I am back home.
(Fade out)

chansons.style: Upbeat modern country festival anthem, lively female vocal, fast acoustic picking, bright fiddle and banjo, energetic and joyful, 115 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: L'ambiance électrique et joyeuse d'un festival de musique country en plein air.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Banjo and fiddle)
[Verse 1]
Got my boots laced up and my favorite hat
Walking down the trail where the fields are flat
Hear the distant tuning of a six string band
Best weekend in the whole wide land
[Pre-Chorus]
Sun is going down and the lights come on
We will be dancing till the break of dawn
[Chorus]
Underneath the neon tents and fiddles
Solving all of life's little riddles
Raise a plastic cup to the starry sky
Watching all our worries passing by
Yeah, the music plays and the good times roll
Festival magic in my soul
[Verse 2]
Strangers become friends in a single song
Singing every lyric loud and strong
Smell the sweet smoke from the barbecue pit
This is where the country lovers sit
[Chorus]
Underneath the neon tents and fiddles
Solving all of life's little riddles
Raise a plastic cup to the starry sky
Watching all our worries passing by
Yeah, the music plays and the good times roll
Festival magic in my soul
[Bridge]
No cell service and we do not care
Just the rhythm floating in the summer air
[Outro]
Keep playing that fiddle.
(Fade out)

chansons.style: Hopeful modern country, emotional male vocal, soft acoustic fingerpicking, gentle pedal steel guitar, reflective and uplifting mood, 100 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un voyage en voiture symbolisant un nouveau départ et l'espoir d'un avenir meilleur.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Soft acoustic picking)
[Verse 1]
Sold the old truck and the rusty plow
Nothing left to tie me to the now
Packed a single suitcase in the trunk
Left the keys beneath the welcome mat
[Pre-Chorus]
Rearview mirror shows a fading past
Moving forward and I'm moving fast
[Chorus]
Out on the open highway of my life
Leaving behind all the tears and strife
A brand new morning and a blank white page
Stepping right onto a brighter stage
The open highway is my only friend
Where the old roads stop and the new ones begin
[Verse 2]
Radio is playing a hopeful tune
Driving underneath a silver moon
Every passing mile is a heavy weight
Lifting off my shoulders at the garden gate
[Chorus]
Out on the open highway of my life
Leaving behind all the tears and strife
A brand new morning and a blank white page
Stepping right onto a brighter stage
The open highway is my only friend
Where the old roads stop and the new ones begin
[Bridge]
I am not afraid of the unknown miles
Trading all my sorrows for a million smiles
[Outro]
Just driving on.
(Fade out)

chansons.style: Intimate modern country ballad, raw male vocal, slow acoustic strumming, crying steel guitar, melancholic and nostalgic small town vibe, 92 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: L'attachement profond aux souvenirs et aux traditions d'une petite ville de province.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Slow steel guitar)
[Verse 1]
The diner on the corner still serves cherry pie
The water tower reaches up into the sky
Paint is peeling off the hardware store
But I love this town right to the core
[Pre-Chorus]
Everybody knows your name and knows your face
Life is moving at a slower pace
[Chorus]
Oh, Main Street memories never fade away
Etched into the stones where the children play
It's a quiet little dot upon the map
But it's the only place I ever want to nap
Hometown glory in the evening light
Everything about this place feels right
[Verse 2]
Friday night football under buzzing lamps
Cheering for the boys and the marching bands
Generations sitting in the very same stands
Holding onto tradition with our own two hands
[Chorus]
Oh, Main Street memories never fade away
Etched into the stones where the children play
It's a quiet little dot upon the map
But it's the only place I ever want to nap
Hometown glory in the evening light
Everything about this place feels right
[Bridge]
They say the world is spinning way too fast
But here we build a love that's meant to last
[Outro]
My sweet hometown.
(Fade out)

chansons.titre_fr: L'été de la balançoire du perron
chansons.style: Romantic modern country, sweet female vocal, gentle acoustic strumming, warm pedal steel, tender storytelling, nostalgic summer romance, 105 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Le souvenir tendre et nostalgique d'un premier amour d'été sur un perron.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Gentle acoustic strum)
[Verse 1]
We were sixteen sitting on the wooden swing
Listening to the crickets and the robins sing
You wore a yellow dress and a daisy crown
Best looking girl in this whole county town
[Pre-Chorus]
Our fingers brushed and my heart took flight
Everything was perfect in the fading light
[Chorus]
That porch swing summer was my first real love
Sent to me from the heavens up above
Sweet like honey and warm like the sun
I knew right then that you were the one
Porch swing summer, holding your hand
The sweetest romance in all the land
[Verse 2]
Shared a soda bottle and a whispered dream
Floating down the river in a wooden beam
You laughed at my jokes and I blushed so red
Remembering every single word you said
[Chorus]
That porch swing summer was my first real love
Sent to me from the heavens up above
Sweet like honey and warm like the sun
I knew right then that you were the one
Porch swing summer, holding your hand
The sweetest romance in all the land
[Bridge]
Years go by but I still see your smile
Haven't thought about you in a little while
Wait, that's a lie, I think of you each day
[Outro]
My first love.
(Fade out)

chansons.style: Sad modern country exile ballad, soulful male vocal, slow acoustic picking, weeping steel guitar, lonely and melancholic atmosphere, 90 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: La solitude et le mal du pays d'un exilé loin de ses forêts de pins du Sud.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Weeping steel guitar)
[Verse 1]
Snow is falling on the city avenue
But my mind is walking through the morning dew
Back where the southern pines touch the sky
Here the concrete buildings just make me cry
[Pre-Chorus]
I hear the wind but it doesn't sound the same
I'm just a stranger playing a lonely game
[Chorus]
I'm exiled miles from the pines I know
Watching the seasons and the rivers flow
Homesick heart beating in a foreign land
Wishing I could hold my daddy's hand
Take me back to the dirt and the clay
Miles from the pines is where I can't stay
[Verse 2]
Coffee in a paper cup tastes like regret
Thinking 'bout the cabin and the fishing net
Every passing siren is a lonesome hound
Missing the quiet of my native ground
[Chorus]
I'm exiled miles from the pines I know
Watching the seasons and the rivers flow
Homesick heart beating in a foreign land
Wishing I could hold my daddy's hand
Take me back to the dirt and the clay
Miles from the pines is where I can't stay
[Bridge]
They say you can't go back but they are wrong
I've been singing this same sad song
[Outro]
Take me home.
(Fade out)

chansons.style: Driving modern country anthem, powerful female vocal, upbeat acoustic rhythm, bright steel guitar, energetic and liberating freedom vibe, 120 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: L'ivresse de la liberté retrouvée en courant à travers les grands espaces.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Driving acoustic beat)
[Verse 1]
Cut the heavy ropes and drop the iron chain
Stepping out the shelter and into the rain
No more fences telling me where to walk
No more shadows making me stop my talk
[Pre-Chorus]
Feel the wind rushing through my messy hair
Breathing in the sweet and untamed air
[Chorus]
I am wild and I am unbroken
Every single promise I have spoken
Running through the meadow like a mustang free
This is what true liberty means to me
Wild and unbroken, chasing down the sun
My life of freedom has just begun
[Verse 2]
Left the heavy baggage by the riverside
Got nothing but the rhythm and the country pride
Boots are hitting gravel in a steady beat
Earth is feeling solid right beneath my feet
[Chorus]
I am wild and I am unbroken
Every single promise I have spoken
Running through the meadow like a mustang free
This is what true liberty means to me
Wild and unbroken, chasing down the sun
My life of freedom has just begun
[Bridge]
No one holds the reins and no one holds the key
The open horizon is calling out to me
[Outro]
I am free.
(Fade out)

chansons.style: Proud modern country stomper, strong male vocal, rhythmic acoustic strum, soaring steel guitar, triumphant and victorious farming pride, 110 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: La fierté d'un agriculteur célébrant une récolte abondante après de durs labeurs.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Stomping beat and acoustic)
[Verse 1]
Worked the rocky soil from the break of day
Chased the bitter storms and the drought away
Hands are calloused and my back is sore
But the silo's full right up to the door
[Pre-Chorus]
We stood our ground when the world said no
Now we're reaping what we managed to sow
[Chorus]
We got that harvest gold shining in the light
Won the heavy battle and we did it right
Standing tall and proud on the family land
Holding the victory right in our hand
Harvest gold, a trophy of the earth
Proving all our struggle and our sweat had worth
[Verse 2]
Neighbors coming over for a grand old feast
Raising up a glass to the gentle beast
Tractor in the barn and the horses fed
Resting up our weary and our happy head
[Chorus]
We got that harvest gold shining in the light
Won the heavy battle and we did it right
Standing tall and proud on the family land
Holding the victory right in our hand
Harvest gold, a trophy of the earth
Proving all our struggle and our sweat had worth
[Bridge]
They laughed at our dreams but we never bowed
Now our country voices are singing loud
[Outro]
We won the harvest.
(Fade out)

chansons.style: Coastal modern country, breezy male vocal, gentle acoustic fingerpicking, subtle steel guitar, calm and reflective oceanic storytelling, 98 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: La contemplation apaisante de l'océan et de la brise marine sur la plage.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Gentle coastal picking)
[Verse 1]
Waking up early to the seagull cry
Watching the colors paint the morning sky
Sand between my toes and the salt upon my lips
Listening to the rhythm of the ocean ships
[Pre-Chorus]
The tide is rolling in to wash the slate
Leaving all my troubles at the garden gate
[Chorus]
Out by the sea where the saltwater blows
Washing away all the worldly woes
The ocean is a singer with a deep low voice
Giving my restless spirit a reason to rejoice
Saltwater breeze and the endless blue
The sea is the only church I ever knew
[Verse 2]
Driftwood scattered on the sandy shore
Every crashing wave tells a little more
About the sailors and the storms they braved
Out upon the waters that the heaven saved
[Chorus]
Out by the sea where the saltwater blows
Washing away all the worldly woes
The ocean is a singer with a deep low voice
Giving my restless spirit a reason to rejoice
Saltwater breeze and the endless blue
The sea is the only church I ever knew
[Bridge]
I could sit and listen to the water's song
Right here on the shoreline is where I belong
[Outro]
Just the sea and me.
(Fade out)

chansons.titre_fr: Berceuse sous le toit de tôle
chansons.style: Moody modern country rain ballad, breathy female vocal, soft acoustic picking, atmospheric steel guitar, intimate and cozy rainy day mood, 94 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Le réconfort d'une journée pluvieuse écoutée sous un toit en tôle.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Soft rain and acoustic)
[Verse 1]
Clouds are gathering in a shade of gray
Chasing all the summer humidity away
First drop hits the dust and the second hits the pine
Nature's little symphony is starting to align
[Pre-Chorus]
Pulling up the blanket and I brew some tea
There is nowhere else I'd rather be
[Chorus]
Listening to the rain on the tin roof above
Singing me a lullaby of peace and love
Pitter patter rhythm on the metal sheet
Washing all the dust from the country street
Tin roof lullaby, sing me to sleep
A promise that the muddy earth will keep
[Verse 2]
Garden getting thirsty for a cooling drink
Watching all the puddles form and start to link
Frog is croaking softly from the water log
Safe and sound inside the morning fog
[Chorus]
Listening to the rain on the tin roof above
Singing me a lullaby of peace and love
Pitter patter rhythm on the metal sheet
Washing all the dust from the country street
Tin roof lullaby, sing me to sleep
A promise that the muddy earth will keep
[Bridge]
Let it pour down heavy let it wash it clean
Best country music that I've ever seen
[Outro]
Sweet rain.
(Fade out)
